propositions: The resolver canonicalizes openai model specs to 'openai-chat:' qualifier but live external tier's credential map keys only 'openai', causing configured_provider() to return a qualifier with no matching credential entry

The live external provider guard compares resolved specs literally against REBAR_EXPECTED_LLM_PROVIDER='openai' (family name) but gets 'openai-chat' (qualifier), producing a false-positive guard failure
All live LLM tests on the openai arm silently skip because live_llm_ready() returns False when configured_provider()='openai-chat' finds no matching credential
Unit-tier matrix gate was updated with family-to-qualifier mapping by commit 8f4c5fdb0d3 but live external tier consumers were not updated, creating an unmet obligation

The fix adds a qualifier-to-family map in the live tier and makes configured_provider() return the family name so all consumers (credential lookup, guard comparisons, skip reasons) align with the declared arm provider
